We’re excited to head to the Fontainebleau Las Vegas for NICA 2026, the premier event dedicated to the non-hospital, provider-administered medication market. As community-based infusion centers navigate rapid market growth and complex care coordination, eFax is ready to show how our cloud-based data transformation solutions help practices optimize their operations.


Connect with the eFax team to learn how we help infusion centers streamline intake and referral management. Our secure, cloud-based communication platforms are designed to automate complex document workflows and safeguard sensitive patient data with iron-clad HIPAA compliance, allowing your administrative and clinical teams to spend less time managing medical paperwork and more time focused on delivering safe, affordable care.
